articles.hook: Anticipation continues to build for Apple's first foldable iPhone coming at next month's event, while subscribers to the Apple TV streaming service are getting hit with another price increase, so read on below for all of the details.

sections.heading: Where the sources line up
sections.body: Apple this week announced that it plans to hold its annual iPhone-centric event on Wednesday, September 9, at the Apple Park campus in Cupertino, California. The event will begin at 10:00 a. m. Pacific Time, with select members of the media invited to attend.

sections.heading: Practical impact for readers
sections.body: The September 2026 iPhone event comes with the tagline "Surprise and Shine" and should see Apple announce the iPhone 18 Pro, the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max, and the foldable iPhone, which could be called the iPhone Ultra. There won't be an iPhone 18 this year because Apple is waiting until spring 2027 to launch the more affordable models.

sections.heading: Who should pay attention now
sections.body: Apple this week announced the next-generation Mac mini , which can be configured with an all-new M6 chip or the M5 Pro chip released earlier this year.

sections.heading: What is still unclear
sections.body: Apple said the Mac mini with the M6 chip delivers up to 40% faster CPU performance, up to 4× faster performance for AI tasks in particular, up to 2× faster graphics performance, and up to 2× faster storage speeds compared to the previous-generation model with the 10-core M4 chip, 32GB of unified memory, and 2TB of storage.

articles.title: Replace slow drafting workflows with AutoCAD LT for just $199
articles.hook: TL DR: AutoCAD LT combines precise 2D drafting , workflow automation, DWG compatibility, and connected collaboration tools in a one-year subscription for $199.
articles.summary: TL DR: AutoCAD LT combines precise 2D drafting , workflow automation, DWG compatibility, and connected collaboration tools in a one-year subscription for $199. Some projects need precise 2D drawings, not a maze of 3D tools you will never touch.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.body: TL DR: AutoCAD LT combines precise 2D drafting , workflow automation, DWG compatibility, and connected collaboration tools in a one-year subscription for $199.

sections.heading: Where the sources line up
sections.body: Some projects need precise 2D drawings, not a maze of 3D tools you will never touch. AutoCAD LT keeps the focus on professional drafting, annotation, and documentation for floor plans, construction drawings, manufacturing layouts, engineering schematics, electrical diagrams, and other technical work.

sections.heading: Practical impact for readers
sections.body: Smart Blocks detects repeated objects and converts them into reusable blocks, while Dynamic Blocks make frequently used elements more flexible. AutoLISP support automates repetitive tasks and customizes workflows. In other words, fewer tedious clicks and more time spent finishing the drawing.

sections.heading: Who should pay attention now
sections.body: Collaboration tools are equally practical. DWG Compare highlights additions, deletions, and modifications between file versions . Trace lets reviewers add feedback without changing the original drawing, and Activity Insights tracks file history, changes, and collaboration events.

sections.heading: What is still unclear
sections.body: Native DWG compatibility lets teams open, edit, save, and share industry-standard files with confidence. AutoCAD LT also works across Windows, macOS, web browsers, and mobile devices.

articles.title: How WhatsApp Upgraded to Secure, Seamless Sign-In for 1 Billion Users with Passkeys
articles.hook: WhatsApp is the world's largest messaging platform, serving billions of users globally. What makes it worth reading is how it could change how digital users react, work, or spend.
articles.summary: WhatsApp is the world's largest messaging platform, serving billions of users globally. It is the default communication tool for people across diverse regions, connecting users through private, reliable, and secure messaging.
articles.dek: WhatsApp is the world's largest messaging platform, serving billions of users globally. It is the default communication tool for people across diverse regions, connecting users through private, reliable, and secure messaging. The useful part sits in the context, the practical impact, and what readers can use to decide the next step.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.body: WhatsApp is the world's largest messaging platform, serving billions of users globally. It is the default communication tool for people across diverse regions, connecting users through private, reliable, and secure messaging.

sections.heading: Where the sources line up
sections.body: "What excites me most is the sheer scale of WhatsApp's impact. Even a small improvement to WhatsApp touches billions of users worldwide," says Mayank Manuja, an Android Engineer on the WhatsApp Registration and Access team who led the design and implementation of passkey-based authentication for WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Practical impact for readers
sections.body: Building for an audience of this magnitude requires navigating a vast range of network conditions, device capabilities, and levels of digital literacy. Recognizing the potential early, WhatsApp committed to adopting passkeys in 2023, becoming one of the first major consumer apps to integrate the technology. By implementing passkeys, WhatsApp aimed to provide a fast, phishing-resistant option that significantly reduces user friction while providing robust protection against account takeovers and credential theft.

sections.heading: Who should pay attention now
sections.body: For WhatsApp, offering multiple access methods is key to making it easier for users to stay connected and regain access when needed. Passkeys offer users a streamlined, one-tap login experience that eliminates phishing risks and functions reliably even in regions where OTP message delivery can be inconsistent.

sections.heading: What is still unclear
sections.body: Underneath, passkeys leverage public-private key cryptography to replace manual entry with biometric or screen lock authentication. This workflow drastically improves sign-in speeds by reducing the process to a single tap via a unified, bottom-sheet interface that keeps users engaged within the app's context. The benefits are twofold: passkeys offer users a streamlined login experience while simultaneously providing robust, native protection against phishing attacks. Crucially, they function reliably even in regions where traditional SMS OTP delivery can be inconsistent.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.body: Gaming on a budget doesn’t have to mean compromising on quality. Whether you’re a casual player or a dedicated enthusiast, finding the right accessories can make the precious hours you get to spend in front of your computer that much better… without emptying your wallet.

sections.heading: Where the sources line up
sections.body: We’ve dug around and found some of the best PC gaming accessories under $100. Not only will you get top-notch performance, but you’ll get great value too. Let’s dive into the gear that proves great gaming doesn’t have to come with a hefty price tag.

sections.heading: Practical impact for readers
sections.body: One of the main things you need for your gaming setup is a proper mouse. There are so many options out there, but we’re particularly in love with the Razer Basilisk V3 X HyperSpeed . With an 18K optical sensor, nine programmable keys, and Chroma RGB, this one’s speedy, versatile, and gorgeous. The Basilisk V3 is also a solid option with a 26K DPI optical sensor and 11 programmable buttons. If you’re into MMOs, then the Naga V2 HyperSpeed may be better with its 19 buttons and 30K sensor.

sections.heading: Who should pay attention now
sections.body: If you’re on a gaming laptop, then you’ll get a ton of mileage out of a USB-C laptop docking station stand like this one by Mukiya . Not only does it support nine different angles, but it also has an integrated dock with ports for 4K HDMI, two USB-A, one USB-C for data, one USB-C with 85W of passthrough charging, as well as SD and microSD card slots. It’s the ultimate accessory for a decked-out gaming laptop.

sections.heading: What is still unclear
sections.body: If you want an even more versatile docking station than the Mukiya above and you don’t need the laptop stand feature, then this Anker 14-in-1 Laptop Docking Station is a great option. It comes with two 4K HDMI ports and another 1080p VGA port, enabling you to add three displays to your gaming laptop. It also has several USB ports, a USB-C PD port with 100W max charging power, SD and microSD card slots, and a Gigabit Ethernet port for stable online gaming.
